Despite Sabbatai Zevi’s promises to make the sultan his slave, his messianic movement culminated in Jewish conversion to Islam. The Kadizadeli reform movement that promoted a rational religion preferred by the sultan prevailed over the competing ecstatic movement of the Jewish mystic.
